prospective_computational_label_rule.endpoint: strong versus weak affinity under the source FP context

evidence: main Experimental Section explicitly names 5a penta-O-methyl and 5b hexa-O-methyl
5a main 1H NMR includes one OH-6-prime and five 3H methyl singlets
5b main 1H NMR has three 6H methyl singlets
Supporting Information NMR headings S6 (5a penta) and S7 (5b hexa) agree with main chemical names
RDKit CSV row 5a contains six O-methyl groups, C34H42F2N6O8S; CSV row 5b contains five, C33H40F2N6O8S
structure_name_correction.curation_action: assign CSV graph labeled 5b to curated compound 5a, and CSV graph labeled 5a to curated compound 5b; preserve original names and strings per row
structure_name_correction.affinity_impact: both source compounds have Kd >100 uM, so swapping the graphs changes no class or censoring value

baseline_audit.interpretation: Do not claim that a successful four-case classifier establishes specificity beyond ligand size. Report both orientations so an arbitrary sign convention cannot hide complete class separation.

required_before_run: freeze a Gal3 receptor and disclose unknown FP construct plus CRD approximation
freeze protonation, glycan conformer generation, seeds and score aggregation without fitting to the affinity classes
retain exact beta-D stereochemistry and corrected 5a/5b graph mapping
report all four rows with raw scores, size baselines and censoring-aware interpretation
recommended_results: strong-versus-weak affinity AUROC as descriptive only
pairwise comparisons with graph and size changes reported
prohibited_claims: an experimental nonbinder class at all concentrations

excluded_source_rows.reason: Table 1 explicitly attributes the affinity to prior reference 30; exclude from the strict four-new-measurement contrast

carpenter_2025_audit.resolution: Both named naive-input files were recovered; normalization and graph-density provenance remain unresolved. No six-case biological labels were promoted.

new_input_recovery.redistribution: Files retain the 48HD site terms/noncommercial restriction and are not copied into the repository.

author_code_audit.finding: No searched term occurs in the six MCNet processing Python files. The complete mirror-image repository tree lists ML training/inference notebooks and models but no named LiGA normalization or barcode-density mapping artifact. This does not prove no such data exist elsewhere.

remaining_exact_ambiguities: MOG0.SDB0 through SDB35 and MOY0.SDB0 through SDB35 require chemical identity plus display density mapping; raw count tables contain barcode classes but no graph/density definitions

MOG naive file contains 11 count columns, MOY naive file 4, and each Gal3 output file 3; which input columns and aggregation generated the comparison-workbook values remains undocumented in recovered assets
whether the comparison-workbook LiGA values are logFC, a transformed statistic, or an aggregation of contexts remains unproved; a negative value alone is insufficient to choose a transform
the published alpha-L-Glc positive class conflicts with the body/Fig S15 generalization of no Gal3 L-monomer binding
actual C8 versus C4 glycosides and phage attachment cannot be replaced by source-model Sp0 graphs without an explicit approximation

overall_decision: The conservative Gal9C panel has six tested positive/conditional-negative C3-epimer pairs with identical chemical composition, size and formal charge within each pair. It supports an exploratory same-assay specificity test. Complete batch/construct metadata and multi-family confirmatory generalization remain open. The Gal3 FP contrast is a source-corrected fallback, and Carpenter LiGA is not promoted.

baseline_audit.interpretation: Size and formal charge cannot separate classes in this epimer panel. The result still concerns one target domain and one synthetic glycoside series.

source_conflicts: Main MD prose claims 6/18 corresponding epimers, but Chart1=6(3,4-dimethyl) and Scheme1=18(3-methyl),19(3,4-dimethyl). SI synthesis header19 and HRMS C15H23NO5 support Scheme1, while body typo says afford20. Use6/19 for graph matching; do not infer MD results applyto19.

SI15/16 synthesis heading reverses methoxy positions versus Main Scheme1. Both are NB for Gal9C and have identical formula, so conditional class unchanged under either assignment. Do not infer Gal9N530vs580 value maps exact regioisomer until resolved.
SI compound 19 synthesis body says afford 20, but its heading, dimethyl NMR pattern, formula C15H23NO5 and main Scheme 1 identify 19. Use the heading/graph plus chemistry and preserve the body typo.

graph_validation.manual_reference_check: main Chart 1 and Scheme 1 images independently inspected; gulo SI systematic names and mass formulas checked

runnable_next_analysis.primary: use the conservative 12 compounds as six paired epimer tests at Gal9C; keep expanded 16 only as named sensitivity analysis

binding-site information regime independently of the chemical labels
exact five-center stereochemistry, protonation and ring conformer generation
seeds, scoring and aggregation without fitting to labels
report: per-compound and per-seed scores with source finite-Kd or NB-at-2mM status
within-pair score direction for six epimer pairs, tie policy declared in advance
descriptive AUROC and balanced accuracy using a score threshold chosen without fitting this panel
heavy-atom-count baseline 0.5 and formal-charge baseline ties
do_not_claim: numeric affinity bound inferred from NB at 2 mM
an independently established atomic binding pose for these compounds
